Attack Vector: Malicious Android apps distributed via Google Play Store
Spear messaging attacks on WhatsApp and Telegram directing victims to Google Play
Method of Attack: Basic information gathering to prepare for more dangerous malware infections
Requesting risky permissions such as READ_CONTACTS and ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION to exfiltrate data
Storing collected data locally using Android's ROOM library and sending it to attacker's C2 server via HTTP
Use of encrypted strings with AES/CBC/PKCS5PADDING and Proguard obfuscation
Indicators of Compromise: C2 server for VPN app: ikhfaavpn.com
Server address for nSure Chat seen in Cobalt Strike operations
